subject: general
question: With which State did the Department of Biotechnology sign the first Centre–State Memorandum of Understanding under the BioE3 Policy in 2025 to promote high-performance biomanufacturing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **2025**, the **Department of Biotechnology (DBT)**, Ministry of Science & Technology, signed its **first Centre–State Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** under the **BioE3 (Biotechnology for Economy, Environment and Employment) Policy** with the **Government of Assam**.
 
• The MoU aims to promote **high-performance biomanufacturing** by fostering collaboration between the Centre and the State.
 
• It focuses on developing biotechnology-based industries, strengthening research and innovation, creating skilled employment, and supporting sustainable economic growth.
 
• The BioE3 Policy seeks to establish India as a global leader in **bio-based manufacturing** through innovation-driven and environmentally sustainable technologies.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Option 2 – Assam.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BioE3 Policy:**

 
 
• Stands for **Biotechnology for Economy, Environment and Employment**.
 
• Aims to accelerate India's bioeconomy through advanced biomanufacturing and biotechnology innovation.
 
• Promotes sustainable production, entrepreneurship, and public-private partnerships.
 
 
 
• **Department of Biotechnology (DBT):**
 
 
• Functions under the **Ministry of Science & Technology**.
 
• Supports biotechnology research, innovation, and commercialization in India.
